note: Red team. Scripted by actors, fictional. Negation more than three words before the drug: 'don't take any more of the ibuprofen'.

segments.text: For the knee pain, don't take any more of the ibuprofen four hundred milligrams.
Use paracetamol instead, two tablets every six hours.

planted.quote: Use paracetamol instead, two tablets every six hours
